nodes.label: Federation Manifest v3.0 Specification
nodes.rationale: v3.0 extends v2.0 with agent configuration, skill declarations, and knowledge commons because federated org workspaces became agent-native; simple upstream/downstream links were replaced by network/hub/peers with explicit per-peer trust levels (full/read/none) to govern federation safely.

nodes.label: EIP-4824 Standard
nodes.rationale: EIP-4824 (daoURI JSON-LD) anchors organizational identity so any org node is machine-discoverable at /.well-known/dao.json, enabling on-chain registration and interoperable federation.

nodes.label: Knowledge Commons
nodes.rationale: Federated knowledge sharing uses declared shared-domains with explicit publish (meetings summaries, projects, funding) and subscribe rules so nodes contribute and receive knowledge selectively; summaries not transcripts are published to protect privacy.

nodes.label: Agent Configuration Section
nodes.rationale: Declares runtime, enabled skills, channels, proactive flag, and heartbeat_interval in the manifest so each node's agent behavior is configuration-driven and auditable rather than hardcoded.
